summary: editable-contracts preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled script with a shuffled numeric string-array (WV8StW rotate routine), hex-obfuscated identifiers, and a numeric-id opcode table. The package advertises itself as a React form-state helper; nothing in that purpose requires shipping an alternate language runtime or executing an opaque bundle at install time. The Bun runtime is fetched specifically to run an obfuscated payload that Node-based scanners would not resolve, so installing the package auto-executes undisclosed code with the installer's user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
